entities.summary: Maurice (Moshe) Fischer was an agent with Mossad LeAliya Bet, an intelligence officer in the Free French army in Lebanon and Syria, the contact person of the Yishuv leadership with French intelligence, an Israeli diplomat, the first Israeli Ambassador to France, Minister to Turkey from 1953 until 1957, deputy director of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Ambassador to Italy from 1961 to 1965.
